reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 32. Nay or No: 4. Not Voting: 4. Of 36 Yea or Nay votes where the Republican majority could be computed, 36 (100%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 211 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
I support modernizing our air traffic control system, and I look forward to evaluating DOT's line-by-line funding request to deliver on this priority. 

I’m ready to fight to deliver for LEX, SDF, CVG, and regional airports in Kentucky as Congress considers this request. https://t.co/19PxPKZ4oj

This week, I voted twice to pass the Major Richard Star Act. I sent a letter to Congressional leadership earlier this year pushing for this bill to be passed so that combat veterans receive the benefits they earned in service on top of disability benefits. I’ll always fight for our veterans!

This week, I voted twice to pass the Major Richard Stat Act. I sent a letter to Congressional leadership earlier this year pushing for this bill to be passed so that combat veterans receive the benefits they earned in service on top of disability benefits. I’ll always fight for https://t.co/C5Zq7eKn2i

The Abraham Accords was a historic peace deal to advance relations between Israel and multiple Arab countries. I look forward working with all parties involved to strengthen the Abraham Accords. https://t.co/5vWOCEkx4V
God bless all our nation’s veterans from the beginning of our country to now. Happy Veterans Day! https://t.co/DTJc1bvyt0
Marines always hold the line! Happy birthday to the @USMC and all the great marines who have served our nation. https://t.co/grNiNYcPmf

On the eve of Veterans Day and in their first official act since the election, Democrats are blocking pay raises for our troops and investments in our national security. 

Our servicemembers have fought for us, and I will always fight for them. My full statement ⬇️ https://t.co/DvbvGvXFkO

From @WSJ: 3.4% growth last quarter, the fastest in a year and better than expected. Growth is how we get higher wages and more jobs. More work to do: keep taxes low, cut red tape, and keep building. https://t.co/NxqPqSHHWl
Today, I join the Hopkins family, the team @KET, and all of Kentucky in mourning the passing of Shae Hopkins. My full statement. https://t.co/5cfehUoqZU

On the eve of the Breeders' Cup here in Lexington, thank you to @NTRA for the chance to sit down today and talk about the future of Kentucky's signature industry. Yearling sales hit record highs after the Big Beautiful Tax Cut, but we have more work to do. https://t.co/MNVxpYZJMc

Kentucky helped power America for generations, and we'll help secure its mineral independence too. 

Congrats to @universityofky on a $1M DOE award to train the next generation of mining engineers. Programs like this are why I backed these federal funds. https://t.co/Av8fiMDqLj
Honored to host Service Academy Day! Thank you to all the great students who came out and who are interested in joining the ranks of the world’s greatest military officers. https://t.co/UJxaaxppK2

Millersburg has its post office back after the 2022 fire. 

With no residential mail delivery, the post office in the center of town is how folks get their mail, see their neighbors and stay connected.

It took years of calls and persistence from local advocates and my office, but none of us quit. We celebrated at the ribbon cutting today with Mayor Hopkins, Community Ventures and @USPS. Congratulations Millersburg!
Calling all students interested in serving our country and learn more about the opportunities available through our nation’s United States Service Academies. https://t.co/e0VvZVNs3F

Huge win for @RJCormanRR, a great Kentucky company. We secured over  $43M to improve the transportation of goods in our region. 

I strongly supported this funding through a letter of support to DOT and personally brought @SecDuffy to Kentucky earlier this year to discuss our

I’m fighting to unleash American energy production, lower diesel fuel costs, and create jobs.

In the meantime, USDA has announced new assistance to help farmers offset diesel fuel costs.

Kentucky farmers can learn more about this program in my full letter below. ⬇️

No law-abiding American should be debanked for their beliefs.

Today, I joined @USComptroller and leaders from coal, firearms, and faith-based organizations to expose politically motivated debanking brought on by Obama/Biden financial regulators and fight to end it. https://t.co/uJUBdbd4Sq

We need to save Kentucky’s hemp industry and protect the farmers who built it. I’m leading the charge to establish clear rules of the road, protect consumers, and keep hemp products out of the hands of children.

Thank you to the Kentucky Heritage Hemp Company for hosting us today for an important conversation about the future of this industry.

Great to be with the @jessaminechambr today. Central Kentucky is primed for growth. I’ll continue fighting to keep taxes low, boost manufacturing, and reduce DC regulations that hold our businesses back. https://t.co/C9oRK9qRQF

Thank you to the Kentucky District Export Council for meeting on the priorities shaping Kentucky’s economic future. From trade and manufacturing to U.S. investment, we need to strengthen Kentucky businesses through opening markets to maintain America’s economic dominance. https://t.co/GaGOGMJ4W9

Great to speak with the @KentuckyCoal! Coal keeps the lights on in Kentucky, producing over 60% of electricity in our Commonwealth. I’ll keep fighting to unleash coal to create jobs, lower costs, and power us into the future! https://t.co/gEwYaQVVcm

Major win for our Central Kentucky Fire Departments. I’m announcing a $190,476 FEMA grant for fire departments serving Versailles, Anderson County, and Frankfort to purchase a new mobile cascade trailer. This will allow firefighters to refill their breathing packs while on calls. 

I’ll always fight to protect our firefighters so that they can protect us!
https://t.co/HmuxvnsflA
Thanks to @ChairmanSelig for carrying forward the promise to make America a home for responsible innovation. https://t.co/V3kdIoUBFJ

Big win for Kentucky and American coal!

China will import at least 10 million metric tons of U.S. coal in 2027 and 2028. I led the push with the WH to prioritize U.S. coal exports with China. 

More coal means more jobs and more investment in Kentucky. I’ll always fight for Kentucky coal! https://t.co/xGV1bVPoXd

Thank you to @SecDuffy for bringing common sense back to America’s fuel economy standards.

Fuel efficiency naturally improves as technology advances. The Biden Administration’s fuel economy targets ignored market realities, raised costs, and created uncertainty for American manufacturers and consumers.

https://t.co/okFsPcsjml

Congratulations to my friend Jim Gagliano on his retirement after more than two decades of service to @jockeyclub 

Jim has been a tremendous advocate for Thoroughbred racing and has dedicated his career to strengthening the sport that means so much to Kentucky. I’m grateful for his years of leadership and friendship, and I wish him and his family all the best in this next chapter.
Kentucky continues to mourn the passing of Trooper Hayden Phillips. I urge all Kentuckians to join me in praying for his family, friends, and fellow troopers. https://t.co/1nqnmAjwLy

Big day for the Millers Creek Fire Rescue in Estill County. Proud to announce a $160,180 federal grant to replace all the SCBA breathing packs our firefighters use on calls. 

We have to protect our first responders so that they can protect us! https://t.co/o82px8h2wT

Great to be with @DC_Reporter @MatthewFoldi this week to talk bourbon and financial services with @EPC_Updates Executive Chairman Richard Hunt. Appreciate @DistilledSpirit hosting us for a special night. https://t.co/cJLHcmMQf7

This week’s summit between President Trump and General Secretary Xi represents an important opportunity to hold the Chinese Communist Party accountable for providing Iran with satellite data it used to target the American military in the Middle East, buying Iranian oil and selling semiconductors used in Iranian weapons. It also represents an opportunity to reinforce deterrence in the Western Pacific by standing by the $11.1 billion in arms sales to Taiwan announced by the Trump Administration in 2025 and not backing off the additional $14 billion in arms sales to Taiwan presently under consideration.

Thank you to @LexKYFire Chief Jason Wells for his career of service to our city. I know the brave men and women of the Lexington Fire Department will carry on Chief Wells’ commitment to protecting and serving our community.  https://t.co/Ayr9Q7fmjc
Big Blue Nation with a Big Day! Congratulations to @CoachWillStein and the @UKFootball wildcats. https://t.co/Xc5Vgv7U1l

Today, I welcomed the @FinancialCmte Subcommittee on Financial Institutions  to the Bluegrass for a field hearing on the Main Street Capital Access Act. 

This bill would expand access to capital that fuels the American dream for families, farmers, and small businesses. Thank you to @eku for hosting and @RepTroyDowning and @Rep_Davidson for attending.

Iran’s terrorist activities and Putin’s war machine depend on access to money and energy revenues.

I helped lead the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctions Act through the House to tighten the screws on those financial networks and give President Trump additional leverage to confront America’s adversaries.

Peace through strength. 

https://t.co/Jaj7AV5lAu

The @keeneland September Yearling Sale is here! 🐎

Last year was a RECORD year after we delivered 100% bonus depreciation in the Working Families Tax Cut.

Here’s to another record-breaking year for @keenelandsales and KY’s signature industry! https://t.co/3PopcfWxmk

The federal government wastes over $500 BILLION a year due to fraud.

I voted to establish a dedicated @TheJusticeDept division to root out fraud and strengthen federal, state, and local partnerships to protect YOUR tax dollars. https://t.co/KSGmWcCcd5

Thank you to Frank Jemley and the @kymanufacturing for the opportunity to talk to members during their DC fly-in week. Whether it be expansion at @Toyota and @Corning or the @Ford battery plant announcement last week, Kentucky manufacturing is on the move after the Working Families Tax Cut created the Made in America Tax Credit and 100% expensing for new facilities.

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Recommit — Main Street Act (H R 6955)
roll_calls.plain_language: H.R. 6955 (Main Street Capital Access Act) lessens and otherwise modifies banking regulations, including those regarding institution formation, supervision by federal financial regulators, and bank merger requirements. A motion to recommit is the minority's last formal chance to send a bill back to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it back; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.
